Lina (compliance): Auditor asks for proof that after the RBAC change we redacted PII before export, envelope-encrypted exports with KMS, and produced per-file SHA256s + signed manifest. Also want vuln-triage linked to IR ticket 2026-IR-47. Can we assemble by EOD?

Maria (sec-eng): Yes. I will produce: redaction rules, sanitized sample lines, manifest.jsonl (per-file JSON lines), manifest.jsonl.sig, redact_test.py to replay, vuln-triage.csv, iam-change.diff and rotation logs, and an audit-note.txt. Quick Q: auditor prefers per-file hashes?

auditor_jones: Per-file SHA256s preferred. Also include chain-of-custody (exported-by, exported-at, KMS key id/version) and a copy of the GPG public key used to sign.

Ajay (infra): I'll run export to s3://redwood-compliance/exports/2026-03-20-rbac-window/ and envelope-encrypt each object with KMS (arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-1234, version 3). Export command used for trace: `aws s3 cp --recursive /var/log/processed/ s3://redwood-compliance/exports/2026-03-20-rbac-window/ --metadata exported-by=ajay,exported-at=2026-03-20T15:10:00Z`

Maria (sec-eng): Redaction rules we applied (CI-tested): `s/email\\S*@\\S+/[REDACTED_EMAIL]/g`, `s/\\b\\d{3}-\\d{2}-\\d{4}\\b/[REDACTED_SSN]/g`, `s/(user_id=)[A-Za-z0-9_-]+/\\1[REDACTED_ID]/g`. Example sanitized line: `2026-03-20T15:02:13Z svc-api request_id=abc123 user_id=[REDACTED_ID] email=[REDACTED_EMAIL] action=get-embedding`

Ajay (infra): Manifest generation: `for f in *.log.enc; do sha256sum "$f" >> manifest.jsonl; done` then `gpg --output manifest.jsonl.sig --sign manifest.jsonl`. Objects include metadata kms-key-id and kms-key-version.

Sam (sec-ops): IR ticket 2026-IR-47 (token leak alert). I will attach the incident timeline and link the upload to the IR ticket. RBAC diff created svc-rw-data and svc-metrics; we rotated creds during the window.

auditor_jones: Please include gpg_pubkey.asc and a sanitized KMS key policy snippet showing Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey principals. Also an exported JSON of the IAM change event.

Maria (sec-eng): Will bundle everything into 2026-03-20-rbac-export-bundle.zip: samples/, manifest.jsonl, manifest.jsonl.sig, iam-change.diff, cloud-audit-event.json, ir-2026-IR-47-timeline.pdf, vuln-triage.csv, redact_test.py, gpg_pubkey.asc, audit-note.txt, README-mapping-to-SOC-controls.md. README will map files to CC6/CC7.

ops-bot: Upload complete: s3://redwood-compliance/exports/2026-03-20-rbac-window/2026-03-20-rbac-export-bundle.zip (signed) :package:

auditor_jones: Received. We'll validate per-file SHA256s against manifest and verify the GPG signature. If we need anything else we'll ping.

Lina (compliance): Once uploaded mark items "evidence:prepared" in the compliance tracker. Thanks everyone.
